description.value: Blenz Coffee is a BC-born specialty coffee chain founded in 1992, serving hand-crafted espresso drinks, organic whole-leaf teas, protein shakes, and a food menu of sandwiches, wraps, baked goods, and more at this Fort St. John location. The brand emphasizes premium ingredients — 100% Arabica beans, single-origin chocolate, and ceremonial-grade matcha — and offers takeout and mobile ordering through its app. For cyclists heading through Fort St. John, it is a convenient in-town stop for hot or cold beverages and a snack.
